captions.detailed: A classic high-top slot machine featuring a black cabinet with a wide upper topper housing and a narrower lower body. The top marquee is decorated with golden-brown trim and stylized lettering, while the middle section contains a yellow-bordered reel window revealing three cylindrical game reels. The lower front features a dark red service door with a white handle, and a silver side pull lever with a red spherical knob is mounted on the right flank. The reels rotate continuously on horizontal axes, the service door opens on a vertical hinge, and the side lever pulls down via a revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a high-top slot machine with a black cabinet, a top marquee housing, a middle reel window, and a lower red service door. Include a side pull lever on the right flank and three internal game reels, setting up continuous rotation for the reels, a revolute joint for the lever, and a hinged vertical rotation for the service door.
captions.factory: Construct the main slot machine housing using two Box primitives (a larger upper topper box and a narrower lower cabinet box). Model the front decorative marquee plate and its text elements using thin Box shapes. Create the reel window frame by subtracting a smaller box from a larger thin box, and place three Cylinder primitives inside to act as the rotating reels. Build the side lever using a Cylinder pivot, a Box arm, and a Sphere handle. Model the front service door and its handle using Box primitives, then define the articulations: continuous joints for the three reels, a revolute joint for the side lever, and a revolute joint for the service door.
